title: Meeting an Old Friend After a Long Time

vocabulary.meaning_en: a friend you have known for a long time
vocabulary.example: I met an old friend from school.

vocabulary.meaning_en: return to live in a place
vocabulary.example: She moved back to her hometown.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feel sad because someone or something is not with you
a person who makes designs and pictures for companies
vocabulary.example: He works as a graphic designer.
The job is challenging but fun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a natural ability to do something well
vocabulary.example: She has a talent for art.

vocabulary.meaning_en: get a higher position at work
the person in charge of a team
vocabulary.example: She is the manager of the sales team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good; making you admire it
stop talking or writing to someone

vocabulary.example: Let's have a picnic in the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a meal where every guest brings a dish
vocabulary.meaning_ar: وليمة يُحضر فيها كل ضيف طبقًا
vocabulary.example: Let's have a potluck on Friday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: food prepared in a certain way
talk about what happened since you last met
vocabulary.example: We have a lot to catch up on.

fine_lines.title: How are you? vs How have you been?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: How are you? عن الحال الآن. How have you been? عن الفترة منذ آخر لقاء، تُستخدم عندما لا ترى الشخص منذ مدة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "How are you?" = now. "How have you been?" = since we last met.

examples.sentence: It's been so long! How have you been?

fine_lines.title: miss vs lose touch
fine_lines.explanation_ar: miss تعني تشتاق إلى شخص أو مكان. lose touch تعني تنقطع الصلة بينكما.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Miss = feel sad someone isn't with you. Lose touch = stop contacting someone.

examples.sentence: We lost touch after she moved.

expressions.meaning_en: Say this when you see someone you didn't expect.
Say you haven't met for a long time.

expressions.phrase: It's great to see you. How have you been?
expressions.meaning_ar: سعيد جدًا برؤيتك. كيف حالك طوال هذه المدة؟
expressions.example: It's great to see you. How have you been?
You're back in town! What brought you back?

expressions.phrase: What have you been up to?
expressions.example: What have you been up to since school?

expressions.phrase: Have you heard from Sarah lately?
expressions.example: Have you heard from Ali lately?
She's doing well. That's good to hear.

expressions.phrase: We should plan another day like that soon.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن نخطط ليوم مثل ذلك قريبًا.
expressions.example: That was fun. We should plan another day like that soon.
We're having a picnic. Count me in!

expressions.phrase: We have a lot to catch up on.
expressions.meaning_en: Say you have much news to share.
expressions.example: Let's sit down. We have a lot to catch up on.

grammar.title: Present perfect: How have you been? / It's been so long
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع التام (have/has + التصريف الثالث) للفترة من الماضي حتى الآن: How have you been? I've been good. It's been so long. What have you been up to?
grammar.explanation_en: Present perfect (have + past participle) for time from the past until now.
examples: I've been good, just busy with work.

grammar.title: Past simple for finished events
grammar.explanation_ar: للأحداث المنتهية نستخدم الماضي البسيط: I moved back to town. We lost touch. I got promoted.
examples: I just moved back to town.
We lost touch after she moved to London.

grammar.title: Suggestions: We should... / Maybe we could...
grammar.explanation_ar: لاقتراح فكرة: We should + الفعل، أو Maybe we could + الفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: Make suggestions with We should... or Maybe we could...
examples: We should plan another day like that soon.
Maybe we could invite more people.
